title: Tavily Search Integration
description: A pattern demonstrating how to integrate Tavily's AI-powered search capabilities with Strands agents for enhanced web research and information retrieval

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The pattern integrates Tavily's AI search engine as a powerful tool for web research
A custom search tool handles API integration and result processing
Search results are analyzed and filtered for relevance using Tavily's AI capabilities
The agent can perform targeted searches and extract specific information
Error handling manages API rate limits and search quotas
